brief: critic for wave-1 piece W1-01 (World shape and traversal budget)
findings: M17 BLIND TEST TAKEN. Raw score 39/39. BUT the pack is NOT SHUFFLED: frames 1-3=blackwood, 4-6=clay-moor ... 37-39=western-rootlands, i.e. strict alphabetical slug order, 3 consecutive per region, and REGIONS.txt lists the names in the same alphabetical order. RI-WLD04 M17 step 3 requires 'Shuffle the 39 images'. 39/39 is therefore not a measurement of region legibility.
ANSWERS.json declares night:false, worst_weather:false. RI-WLD04 M17 step 6 (night >=70%, worst weather) is UNMEASURED -> fail-closed for that half.

Genuinely low-confidence before reveal: Eastern Rootlands frames 13/14/15 - assigned BY ELIMINATION. No floating meadow, no tannin-black channel, no stilt row, no tideway marker visible. Blackwood 02/03 also marginal (first guess was Thornmarsh; resolved only by blue welkynd glints at native res).

CROSSING REPRODUCED EXACTLY: 56.574 min / 6788.3 m / mean 1.9998 m/s / 4 of 33944 samples below 1.6. Artifact critic-crossing-walk.json. walkRoute drives the real capsule through loop.stepOnce(), not a spline teleport - verified.

S17 from the other side: walk is 2.0000 m/s on EVERY terrain probed (road, 424 m ridge, W2 marsh water, SUCK substrate); 60 s walk = exactly 120.0 m; stamina 120->120; no movement drain; accel ramp exists but reaches 1.97 by 60 f. NOTHING was slowed to pad the clock. S17 SATISFIED.

THE DEFECT: at tide LOW the Stormhold-Helstrom leg of THE CROSSING runs 538 m through over-knee water, 502 m of it over chest (W5), max depth 65.64 m at (2182.52, 2214.63) - ground_y 69.66, water surface_y 135.30. Player stands there state IDLE, HP 620/620, walks it at 2.0 m/s. Screenshot shot-drowned-road-stormhold-helstrom.png is a black underwater frame. helstrom-gideon adds 72 m of W5 at 6.9 m deep.

M17 pack unshuffled (frames 1-3=blackwood ... 37-39=western-rootlands, alphabetical). Raw 39/39 is void. Machine analogue (critic-visual-dispersion.mjs): LOO nearest-centroid 26/39 = 66.7%; Blackwood<->Thornmarsh confused 4x (RI-WLD04 M17 step 5 named defect); centroid distance 18.9 vs next-closest 38.7.
A7 PASSES: our 13 regions are MORE dispersed than Morrowind's own REF-A21-regions (Fisher 3.01 vs 1.417; LOO 66.7% vs 25.6%). Caveat: MW refs vary in ToD/weather/camera, ours do not.
M18 reproduced (all 78 pairs >= 8 axes) BUT 8 of 9 axes are read from regions.json declarations; only the slope histogram is measured on built geometry (and wins only 60/78).
RI-PRG07 world.traversal: equip load 10/24/45/69/79/95/105% -> walk speed 2.0000 m/s at EVERY tier including OVERLOADED. Encumbrance does nothing outside the fight = the item's own 0 cell.

RI-CAM02: turn rate exactly 12.00 deg/frame = 720 deg/s (M4 moving ceiling, at the bound). Camera-relative mapping PASSES - travel bearing tracked camera yaw over 6 yaws exactly. My first camera test was INVALID: __HARNESS.camera(pose) sets a debug override, not sim.camera.yaw.
